titel: Error Detecting and Error Correcting Codes
kennung: [link removed 2026-08-19 — a course page hosting another author's text; rights unsettled]
url: [link removed 2026-08-19 — a course page hosting another author's text; rights unsettled]
zusammenfassung: Founding paper of error-correcting codes. Turns a codeword into a point in an n-dimensional cube and defines the distance D(x,y) as the number of coordinates in which x and y differ (Hamming distance) — 'the least number of edges which must be traversed in going from x to y', a metric. Table V ties minimum distance to capability: distance 1 = uniqueness; 2 = single-error detection; 3 = single-error correction ('any single error will leave the point nearer to the correct code point than to any other code point'); 4 = single-error correction PLUS double-error detection; 5 = double-error correction. The (7,4) code (d=3) corrects any one bit; the extended (8,4) code (d=4) is single-error-correcting, double-error-detecting (SECDED). Full 1950 scan read directly S30; distance definition, geometric packing model, and Table V verbatim.
relevanz: A third face of error for the project, beside LOSS (model collapse) and BIRTH (differential reproduction): error as a BOUNDED, correctable quantity with a hard geometric edge. Past minimum distance, a bounded-distance decoder does not fail — it miscorrects, returning a valid but wrong codeword and reporting success (works/2026-07-16-the-wrong-sphere enumerates all 21 double-flip miscorrections of the (7,4) code exhaustively). The gap between reliability and honesty; SECDED's extra bit as the machine analogue of negative knowledge (a representable 'I cannot fix this'). Bridges to work 22 (Negative Knowledge).

titel: Self-organization of matter and the evolution of biological macromolecules (quasispecies / error threshold)
zusammenfassung: Origin of quasispecies theory and the ERROR THRESHOLD: a self-replicating information sequence can be maintained only below a critical per-site mutation rate (the Eigen condition L < ln(sigma)/p, of order 1/L); above it the 'error catastrophe' destroys the information (at p=1/2 no information is retained). In the classical lethal-error model 'an imperfect copy leads to elimination of the offspring.' 1971 German primary NOT read directly (F-038-class caveat); the condition and the ~1/L threshold verified S27 via two independent retrievable expositions: arXiv:2406.14516v1 (Eigen condition, lethal-error model) and theory.epfl.ch/vishnoi/Publications_files/VError.pdf ('around 1/L'; p=1/2 loses all information).
relevanz: Supplies the principled inverted-U for differential reproduction: kept difference (novelty that is inherited) exists only between mu=0 (frozen reproduction) and the error threshold (~1/L), which the atelier's own seeded experiment (works/2026-07-14-differential-reproduction) reproduces to order of magnitude. The BIRTH-side counterpart to the model-collapse LOSS-side line (Shumailov/Gerstgrasser).

titel: A Mathematical Theory of Communication (noisy-channel coding theorem)
zusammenfassung: Founds information theory and states the noisy-channel coding theorem: for a discrete memoryless channel there is a capacity C such that, for any rate below C, error-correcting codes exist that make the probability of error arbitrarily small; above C reliable communication is impossible. Reliability as high as desired is achievable — but only below capacity, and never at zero redundancy cost. PRIMARY NOT read directly this session; used only as the frame around Hamming's construction. Statement corroborated via a retrievable secondary (Wikipedia, Noisy-channel coding theorem) and expositions (gaussianwaves; IITK lecture notes home.iitk.ac.in/~adrish/Shannon).
relevanz: The frame that makes error correction a science rather than a wish: error is not eliminated but bounded, and the bound has a price (redundancy) and a ceiling (capacity). Context for work 24; the load-bearing claims there are Hamming's distance geometry, not Shannon's theorem.
